metadata.candidate_matching_policy: Exact full name after comma reordering, removing punctuation/spaces and honorifics DR/MR/MRS/MS only; exact year/state/office/district (AK/SD House at-large API01 maps FEC00). No shortened first names, omitted middle names, nickname aliases, answer-order or party inference. Unmatched answers remain unverified.
metadata.coverage: 22 provider-sourced polls across 17 races; incomplete convenience sample
limitations: The API has no answer-party metadata; supplied primary candidate evidence is required for exact labels.
FEC candidate affiliation establishes a reported party, not ballot nomination certification.
Candidate-only rows are a research sensitivity input, not primary-reviewed current forecasting data.
Provider-created date is not a verified publication date; exact availability remains unobserved without a primary review.
Partisan/internal polls and ambiguous duplicate survey questions are excluded under this conservative QA policy.
The feed is an incomplete convenience sample of races and cannot justify chamber-control probabilities.
Every included sample count remains unverified; the engine uses placeholder n=1000 rather than claiming source subgroup n.
Some provider samples may refer to registered-voter totals rather than the reported likely-voter subset.
No pollster mode, likely-voter screen or weighting adjustment is inferred from an absent API field.
Current House geography follows the poll label; no previous-district baseline or map transfer is used.
Alaska ranked-choice races are excluded because first-choice D/R margins do not identify final-round outcomes.
Primary snapshot matching firm/contest/field windows take precedence over provider variants, including leaned-voter shares.

sources.coverage: 302 feed records; 178 House/Senate questions before conservative QA.
limitations: CC-BY-4.0; API contains no per-answer party metadata.
created_at is a provider-added date, not a verified publisher release.
sources.title: VoteHub October 2026 public polling API snapshot

sources.coverage: Exact full-name, office, state and district matches restricted to election year 2026.
limitations: FEC affiliation is candidate-reported; FEC registration is not certification of nomination, current ballot access or general-election matchup.
Candidates with nicknames or omitted middle names remain unmatched even when a likely real-world match exists.
FEC file includes future/prior election years and non-nominees; matching restricts election_year2026 and race geography/office.
Only DEM and REP codes are usable as D/R labels; independent, DFL, OTH and other party codes are not automatically recoded.
Source ZIP contains public candidate-registration records, not voter-level data; normalized evidence excludes addresses.
ZIP modification date has no timezone; retrieval timestamp is authoritative snapshot time.
